package.description: Software GUI for Remote Control of SLS60x Light Sources

en-US.description: Software GUI for Remote Control of SLS60x Light Sources
en-US.longDescription: The SLS60x software GUI’s controls duplicate most front panel functions, including intensity adjustment, turning the light source on/off, opening and closing the shutter, and activating/deactivating the ports on the back panel. The software GUI and front panel controls are enabled at the same time. Both constantly read the light source's status and update their displayed information accordingly (e.g. any adjustments made to the light source using the front panel is registered by and used to update the status of the GUI).
en-US.name: SLS60x

zh-CN.description: SLS60x 光源远程控制软件图形用户界面
zh-CN.longDescription: SLS60x 软件图形用户界面的控件复现了前面板的大部分功能，包括强度调节、光源开关、快门启闭以及背板端口的激活/禁用。软件界面与前面板控件可同时操作，二者持续读取光源状态并实时更新显示信息（例如通过前面板对光源进行的任何调整都会被系统记录，并同步更新至图形界面的状态显示）。
